_comment: Normal-GEMM (M > 1) shapes for the Toroidal DualMode array driven through the STOCK tiled schedule, no accumulator. Every tile is validated on its own, so nothing here has to divide an accumulator panel — the shapes only need to exceed the array's tile capacity in each dimension so the multi-tile path is covered. The widest config in 5.toroidal_dual_mode.json has 16 output ports and a 16-deep contraction pass, so 16x16x16 fills it exactly while 8x8x16 leaves the broadcast configs partly filled (padding path).
